artifact: CPO sparse canonical rank-local prototype validation

partition_equivalence.comparison: searchsorted+clone rank-local idx/ref vs direct global boolean partition filter

claims: A release-format dense mask can be converted to a trainer-canonical sparse representation without changing tested pending-gradient or partial-loss algebra.
Dropping noncanonical state_dict-only aliases/buffers is safe only with respect to the tested trainer namespace contract; it is not a claim about arbitrary consumers.
Two CPU searchsorted bounds plus clone reproduce direct rank filtering for sorted global indices in the tested cases.
global_n_masked must remain global; replacing it with rank-local support changes coordinate scaling under support imbalance.
limitations: Executed under torch 2.10.0+cpu, not the CPO-pinned torch 2.8.0.
DeepSpeed 0.16.4 hook/reduce-scatter behavior was not executed in this runtime.
No real Qwen3-VL checkpoint, GPU RSS, bus traffic, or wall-clock profile was measured.
This prototype preserves current public-code per-tensor selection/normalization semantics; it does not implement paper-spec global TopP/global normalization.
The previously identified ZeRO-3 1/world_size regularizer attenuation is intentionally not corrected here.
